text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —And then, the day of the Champions Cup arrived.

text_block_list.name: Tarumae's Fan A
text_block_list.text:
—Incredible...! Tarumae-chan is going to run
in front of all these people...!
Good luck...!

text_block_list.name: Tarumae's Fan B
text_block_list.text:
If it's Hokko Tarumae, she can definitely
go toe-to-toe with Wonder Acute and the others...!
Please, become the new rising star of dirt...!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"There are so many supportive replies to this morning's post...!
And so many people saying they've come out to the racecourse to watch...!"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Alright... yes, yes!
Promoting it all over the place really paid off...!
choice_data_list: Now all that's left is to deliver results!
Now all that's left is to deliver results!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Yes!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
...I'm definitely going to bring Tomakomai
to everyone who came out today...!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Alright then, I'm off!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: (What is this...?! The air is so heavy...! I feel like I'm suffocating...!)

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
(Is this the pressure of the Senior Class...
at the very frontline of dirt racing...?!)

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: —Take a deep breath~ Tarumae-chan.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Listen slooowly to the sound of your own heartbeat,
and just breathe in, and breathe out.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Acute-san...!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu, that's Tarumae-chan for you.
Fitting in so quickly, what a good girl, good girl.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you very much, Acute-san.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
(Her words are the usual Acute-san, but her aura is completely different...!
My very instincts are screaming in fear—)

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"—Hit us with everything
you've got right now, Tarumae-chan."

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: We'll show them everything we've got, too. With all our pride as those running ahead.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: (Don't let them overwhelm you...! Don't lose...!)

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
(“We can definitely change it”...!
Trainer plucked up the courage
to say that to me...!)

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: (That's why I, too—)

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: —I'll challenge Acute-san and the others with everything I've got!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah. That's the spirit.
Well then—

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Let's see whose light shines brighter, then...!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Ooh~! Tarumae is amazing...!
She's not backing down an inch against the great Wonder Acute...!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I'm definitely going to learn a lot from the two of you today.
From watching you run...!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Acute-san... Tarumae-chan...
Everyone...—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I'll be watching right here.
The radiance of dirt racing, right now...!
